gold.user: A project manager wants to redact sensitive information from a document before sharing it with external stakeholders. They prepare the document and submit it to the API for redaction.
gold.ideal: The API successfully processes the document and returns a job ID for tracking the redaction status.

gold.user: After submitting a document for redaction, the project manager wants to check the status of the redaction job using the job ID provided by the API.
gold.ideal: The API returns the current status of the redaction job, indicating whether it is in progress, completed, or failed.
